general_information.name: SORRY — DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS? I’M A BIT MIXED UP. IT’S DAVID… AND THEN QUINN, I THINK, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE THING EXACTLY AS IT’S WRITTEN.
general_information.psychiatrist_name: SORRY, I’M MUDDLING IT UP AGAIN — IT’S DR. BENNETT, I THINK, BUT I CAN’T PULL THE FIRST NAME CLEANLY JUST NOW. COULD YOU ASK IT ANOTHER WAY?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been… my son dying, and the grief after that, and I feel sad all the time. I can’t concentrate properly either, and mornings are awful — I wake too early, around 4:30. I’m exhausted, and I keep thinking I should have been the one who died instead.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to cope with losing him somehow, and get back to functioning again. And… I suppose to keep his memory in a good way, not just this constant mess.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: It was in my 30s, I think… and there were two episodes, one in 1998 and another in 2003. Dr. Laura Bennett was the psychiatrist.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Depression. I had two prior episodes.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — individual psychotherapy, I think that’s what it was called. It was back in 1998.; 1998.; About 16 weekly sessions.

medications.past_medication_details: Past medication 1: Name Or Description: Sertraline.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Dates Or Duration: I took it for about 18 months in my 30s, and then I stopped after I’d recovered properly.; Discontinuation Reason: It was stopped after sustained recovery.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My parents. They’re my parents, and they had depression.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Depression.; Additional Details: My son died by suicide.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: About half a bottle nightly.; Duration: About 6 weeks at this level.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up… just, you know, normally, I suppose. Nothing much else to say there.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married. That’s the main relationship I’d mention.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to recover, and… honour my son’s memory somehow.
